system.description:
The war-song tradition of the Red Waste tribes and their allies at Treaty Hold: epic verse, battle cries and histories of the dead carried in memory, because paper doesn't survive the desert.

  • War Poem: while you recite a war-poem during combat, your Exalt also lets allies reroll 1s on weapon damage dice. Keeping the war-poem going takes part of your action each round; if it lapses, Exalt goes back to checks and saves only.
    • 9th level: allies reroll 1s and 2s.
  • Oral Historian: Advantage on Legend Lore checks on oral histories, lineages, tribal politics and old wars.
